criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: One dark world, most frames one subject on a dark field. Frames 1, 5 and 9 pass or nearly, and slide 5's encoding checks against the pixels. Frame 4 is one flat mid grey slab (v = 0.9 for every tile) running into the chin, the highest canvas mean. Frame 3's pod is toy-like with a pale boom polygon behind it. Frame 6's brick is a procedural tile. Frame 2 has a brown haze and boxy trucks.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One deck with three working continuity devices and a dark value run, except the interior on 4. Slide 8's cyan label and tag sit uneasily with the storyboard's rule that cyan means a computer vision observation.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces, every rejection honoured, universals declared. Four looser spots: slide 2's 50 trucks, 100 cameras as one present fact; slide 3's Staff decide and the caption's review sentence in the deck's voice; slide 8's label level with the sixth arm; the windrow sized from c31 with no frame citing c31, and the first comment leaving out c1 and c41.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What happened is clear at city level. No named decider for the deployment, nothing a resident can do, the caption closes on a rhetorical question. Slide 6 has the one concrete household stake.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The order runs camera, review, count, letter, inspection, then the turn at 8 answered by 9. Frames 1 and 2 and frames 4 and 5 repeat a beat.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and restrained, house rules hold, Dallas generic rather than Texan. The document title can read as staff choosing what the camera flags.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Same program as no. 31 37 days back, lastLight again, a hero vehicle opener, count as object at one scale the house device. The rack and the bare arm are fresh.

ship_note: No hard fail. A threshold dissent, 6.90 under round 2's 7.7 rung.
one_sentence_fix: Attribute slide 3's Staff decide and slide 2's 100 cameras to the city's own plan rather than the deck's voice, and name who approved the cameras and when a resident can next speak once that is fetched.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: One flat mid grey slab because every tile uses v = 0.9, the canvas running into the chin, no person under The reviewer.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: v = STEP[sv] so the tiles fall into value runs, the screen scaled to the display rectangle, a reviewer's shoulder and hand in the left foreground.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A toy pod, a cartoon ring lens, an unlit pale boom polygon behind it.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Hide or darken the boom on this frame, a darker coated glass lens with a thin specular rim.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A procedural brick tile, a flat black grid on the shadow face, the letter a pale glyph on a dead lawn.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Per unit brick variation, darker mortar on the shadow face, a low key across the open box.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A brown mid tone haze behind the dek and identical toy trucks.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Fog to the near black sky above the far rows, a lower camera so the near two cabs are cut large.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The label level with the sixth arm.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Anchor the label at the seventh arm's y directly left of the tag.
